programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Unique Space Jobs"

programs.title: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Extreme Labs"
programs.desc: Host Emily Calandrelli boards the world’s largest flying observatory, dives to an underwater habitat, and explores a laboratory nearly a mile underground.

programs.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Mercury or Bust"
programs.desc: The ESA - JAXA joint Bepi-Colombo Mission is moments away from launch. The target is Mercury which has been too long neglected; this mission will shed new light on this strange world of light and dark.

programs.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Hyabusa2"
programs.desc: The Japanese Asteroid sample return mission has reached its target and is surveying the space rock ready to dip down and take a sample. The return of asteroid material to Earth will aid scientists in the evolving asteroid planetary defense systems.

programs.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Eyes to the Heavens"
programs.desc: Two new space telescopes are in orbit and completing their shakedown; Gaia and TESS they too will be joined by the James Webb Telescope. Together they will be opening up a whole new vista into time and space.
